limitations: All six fresh-seed 128k-exposure endpoints and all failures. Same reused V0 validation families; report actual prediction work and separate seed variation. No cross-horizon causal claim, matched-CNN inheritance, untouched test, matches or TPU use.

novelty.scope: Exact D4-canonical reduced source inputs before rendering. Neutral keys describe actual constant-vision inputs; current keys do not certify absence of FP32 retinal collisions. No labels or final-test examples inspected.

plan.decision: A provisional optimizer candidate requires policy KL improvement in each paired seed and no worsening of mean value MSE. plan.pairing: Compare candidate minus reference on identical validation indices within each seed, then average paired predictions per position before resampling opening families. Report every seed difference and its sample SD separately.
plan.scope: All six fresh-seed 128k-exposure endpoints and all failures. Same reused V0 validation families; report actual prediction work and separate seed variation. No cross-horizon causal claim, matched-CNN inheritance, untouched test, matches or TPU use.
plan.uncertainty: Use the existing opening-family bootstrap: 1,000 resamples, seed 709. Report conditional family intervals and the three paired-seed differences/sample SD separately. The same validation families have been reused in earlier studies.
